step1_analysis.description: A fully differential telescopic cascode OTA used as the core transconductor in a continuous-time OTA-C filter. It features NMOS input pairs, NMOS cascodes, and PMOS cascode current source loads.

paper_reference.title: A 2-Vpp 80–200-MHz Fourth-Order Continuous-Time Linear Phase Filter With Automatic Frequency Tuning

paper_reported.value: 44 dB (Note: paper reported THD as 44dB, gain assumed high)

sky130_expected.calculation: gm * Rout. With W_nmos=5u, W_pmos=20u, I_tail=100uA: gm ~ 526uS, Rout ~ 5.9MOhm -> Gain ~ 3100 V/V = 69 dB
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends strongly on channel length modulation (lambda) of the cascode devices in SKY130.
Matches the filter operating frequency range reported in the paper.

sky130_expected.calculation: Dominant pole at output, non-dominant poles at cascode nodes. With 1pF load, PM should be > 60 deg.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard requirement for OTA stability in feedback configurations.
Based on 100uA tail current bias and 1.8V supply.
Filter-level metric. Open-loop OTA will clip with large signals, so THD is measured in closed-loop filter.

group_delay_ripple.description: Variation in group delay across the passband

sky130_expected.reasoning: Filter-level metric, depends on the closed-loop pole locations.

step3_testbench.description: Measures open-loop DC gain, GBW, phase margin, power consumption, and transient step response of the fully differential telescopic cascode OTA. Uses a 1GH inductor trick to perfectly stabilize the output DC common-mode voltage without loading the AC response.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Telescopic Cascode OTA Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=20u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=20u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=20u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=20u L_xm8=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N0 LABEL_NET_1 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N3 LABEL_NET_2 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N4 LABEL_NET_4 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N2 LABEL_NET_5 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N5 LABEL_NET_6 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N3 N8 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N7 N6 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N7 LABEL_NET_7 N5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

* Power Supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* Biases (Adjusted for SKY130 saturation)
V_PBIAS1 LABEL_NET_5 0 1.1
V_PBIAS2 LABEL_NET_6 0 1.1
V_PCAS1 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.7
V_PCAS2 LABEL_NET_7 0 0.7
V_NCAS1 N8 0 1.2
V_NCAS2 N6 0 1.2
I_TAIL N1 0 100u

* Inputs (DC 0.9V, AC 1Vpp diff, 2mV diff step for Tran)
V_INP LABEL_NET_1 0 dc 0.9 ac 0.5 pulse(0.9 0.901 10n 1n 1n 40n 100n)
V_INN LABEL_NET_4 0 dc 0.9 ac -0.5 pulse(0.9 0.899 10n 1n 1n 40n 100n)

* DC Stabilization (Huge Inductors to set output CM to 0.9V)
L1 N3 VCM 1G
L2 N7 VCM 1G
VCM VCM 0 0.9

* Load Capacitors
C1 N3 0 1p
C2 N7 0 1p

* Differential Output
Bdiff OUT_DIFF 0 V=V(N7)-V(N3)

.control
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

ac dec 100 1 1G
let gain_db = vdb(OUT_DIFF)
let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(OUT_DIFF))
let pm = 180 + phase

meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
meas ac gbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac phase_margin find pm when gain_db=0 fall=1

tran 1n 200n
meas tran t_rise trig v(OUT_DIFF) val=0.0 rise=1 targ v(OUT_DIFF) val=0.1 rise=1

quit
.endc
